notes.title: Add an installed wall
added: New Installed Wall. You enter the wall, the site, and the warranty start and end dates.
notes.how: Open Installed walls. Click New Installed Wall. Enter the wall name and the warranty start and end. Save. Open a row later to change it.

notes.title: RMA fills the page
changed: RMA uses the same wide list and card as Dealer book.
notes.how: Open RMA. The list is on the left. Click a column header to sort, move, hide, or resize it. Drag the divider if you want the list wider. New RMA, or a row, opens the return in the card on the right.

notes.title: Installed walls has a card
added: A card at the top of Installed walls that shows how many walls you have.
changed: The wall list fills the page the same way Dealer book does. You can search it, and the column names stay readable.
notes.how: Open Installed walls. The card shows the count. The table fills the left side. Drag the divider to make it wider. Search a wall, customer, or site, then open a row for the address, serials, and spare kit.

notes.title: Spec PDFs open
changed: Product Spec downloads the sheet instead of stopping at NovaStar’s Access Denied page.
added: Spectrum’s own product PDF is listed on Product Spec for BK, MK, and XP.

notes.title: Spec PDFs open
changed: Product Spec in Dealer book downloads the sheet instead of stopping at NovaStar’s Access Denied page.
added: Spectrum’s own product PDF is listed on Product Spec for BK, MK, and XP.

notes.title: Website spec PDFs are on the item
added: Product Spec on an inventory item lists the PDF from the matching website product.
notes.how: Open Inventory and pick an item. Open Product Spec. The same PDF that is on the website Downloads tab is listed there.

notes.title: Product Spec shows the website PDF
added: Dealer book Product Spec opens the PDF from the website for that product.
notes.how: Open Dealer book and pick an item. Open Product Spec. The sheet is the same PDF as the website.

notes.title: Start here on Dashboard
added: A Start here card on the right side of Dashboard. It uses the top half. Recent is its own card in the bottom half.
changed: When every Start here step is done, the Start here card goes away and Recent uses the whole right side.
notes.how: Open Dashboard. Use Open on Dealer book, Calculator, Deal registration, and Request Quote. A step checks itself when it is saved. When all four are done, only Recent stays on the right.

notes.title: The phone dashboard scrolls
removed: The Overview title above the dashboard cards.
changed: On a phone, swipe the dashboard. The cards stay under the top bar. The detail, then Recent or Lobby, move underneath.
The last panel stops above the bottom bar.

notes.title: Quote lines show sell price
changed: On a Request Quote, SKU is the first column and Item is next to it.
Sell price sits in front of Dealer price.

notes.title: New Request Quote
changed: The button that starts a quote is named New Request Quote.
While you write a Request Quote, Customer, PO number, Terms, Valid until, S.O. No., Tracking, Customer name, Email, Discount, and Tax stay hidden. They show on the quote Spectrum sends back.

notes.title: A new lead starts in New
removed: Incoming, and Accept and Decline on a lead.
added: A new lead from Spectrum shows on Leads, in the New column, with the list and the detail under the board.
notes.how: Open Leads. The card is already in New. Drag it when the job moves. The list under the board opens the same lead. To turn a lead down, call or email Spectrum.

notes.title: Brands and price rules are in Settings
added: A Brands page under Settings. Each brand has a Price setting for Sell, Dealer, and Integrator prices, including a percent per product type.
A customer shows that default percent, and you can type a different one.
changed: Changing Cost on an inventory item asks before Sell, Dealer, and Integrator prices change.
notes.how: Open Settings, then Brands. Click a brand and open Price setting. Sell price is cost increased by a percent. Dealer and Integrator can be cost increased by a percent, or Sell price decreased by a percent. Add a product type when that type needs its own percent. On a customer, the Price block shows the default. Type a percent there to use a different one for that customer. On an inventory item, change Cost and choose Update prices or Leave prices.

notes.title: Price levels are in Settings
added: A Price level page under Settings.
notes.how: Open Settings, then Price level. Add a level. Choose customers, then all products, a product type, or specific items. Pick Sell price, Dealer price, or Net price, then a percent up or down. Add a brand line when one brand needs a different percent. The list shows the adjusted price. You can type over a row. Save keeps the level.

notes.title: Leads from Spectrum
added: A Leads inbox for jobs Spectrum sends you.
notes.how: Open Leads. A new lead is already in New. Drag the card as the job moves. To turn one down, call or email Spectrum. Your own jobs stay in Deal registration.

notes.title: Send a lead to a dealer
added: A Leads page under Dealer.
notes.how: Open Dealer, then Leads, or send a company lead with Send to dealer. It shows on their Leads board in New. They cannot add their own list on that page.

notes.title: Dealer Portal has a phone bar
added: A glass bar at the bottom of the Dealer Portal on your phone.
notes.how: The first five are Book, Calculator, Deals, Quote, and Orders. Tap Calculator to open Projects and Saved Panel. Press and hold the bar to change which pages sit there. Five is the max. Done saves it on this phone. Reset puts the original five back. The side menu still has every page. On Calculator the bar turns dark so the words stay white.

notes.title: Phone bar shows the page through it
changed: On iPhone the bottom bar is see-through glass again.
notes.how: Open Company on your phone. The bar should blur the page behind it, on Inventory and on Calculator.

notes.title: Calculator bar stays readable
changed: On Calculator the phone bar turns dark glass with white labels.
notes.how: Open Calculator on your phone. The bar stays glass, and the words stay white so you can read them on the dark wall. Other pages keep the light glass bar.

notes.title: Phone bar glass is clearer
changed: The bottom bar is clearer glass, so the page shows through it.
notes.how: On Calculator the wall runs full screen under the bar. The bar blurs whatever is behind it, the same on every phone page.

notes.title: Phone bar is a glass pill
changed: The bottom bar floats above the screen with rounded corners and a frosted glass look.
notes.how: The five menus stay the same. Press and hold still lets you change which ones sit there. The row that opens above Inventory, CRM, or Dealer uses the same glass.

notes.title: Start here on the Dashboard
added: A checklist in the main Dashboard card for a new dealer.
notes.how: Sign in and open Dashboard. The large card on the left is Start here: Dealer book, Calculator, Deal registration, and Request Quote. Open a step to do it. The box checks itself when that thing is saved. Dealer book checks when a price is on your book. Calculator checks when you save a wall or a panel. Deal registration checks when you submit a job. Request Quote checks when you send a request. When those last three are done, the card goes back to the usual snapshot. If you already saved a wall, a registration, and a quote, you will not see the list.

notes.title: Install Spectrum Dealer Portal on this computer

steps.label: Chrome
lines: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar.
If the icon is missing, click the three dots, then Cast, save, and share, then Install page as app.

steps.label: Edge
lines: Click Apps, then Install Spectrum Dealer Portal.

notes.how: Safari on a Mac does not install this app. Use Chrome or Edge. The app opens in its own window.

notes.title: Install Spectrum Company App on this computer

steps.label: Chrome
lines: Click the install icon at the right of the address bar.
If the icon is missing, click the three dots, then Cast, save, and share, then Install page as app.

steps.label: Edge
lines: Click Apps, then Install Spectrum Company App.

notes.how: Safari on a Mac does not install this app. Use Chrome or Edge. The app opens in its own window.

steps.label: iPhone
lines: Tap Add. The icon says Dealer Portal.

steps.label: Android
lines: Tap Install app. If you do not see it, tap Add to Home screen.
Tap Install. The icon says Dealer Portal.

notes.title: Menu follows the job
changed: Company menu order is CRM, Customer, Dealer, then Inventory, Vendor, Calculator, and Website.
Installed walls is under Customer.
Settings opens Company. What’s new and Company guide sit at the bottom of Settings.
notes.how: The pages are the same, and the addresses did not change. Open Customer to find Installed walls. Click Settings to land on Company.

notes.title: Menu follows the job
changed: The menu follows the job: price book, calculator, registration, quote, purchase order, installed wall, then RMA.
notes.how: The pages are the same, and the addresses did not change. Size the wall, register the job, request the quote, then open the purchase order.

notes.title: Phone bar holds five menus
added: Press and hold the bottom bar to choose which menus sit there.
changed: The phone bar shows five menus: Calculator, Inventory, CRM, Dealer, and Chat.
notes.how: Press and hold any icon on the bottom bar until they wiggle. Drag to change the order. Tap the red minus to take one off. Tap a name in the row above to add it. Five is the max. Done saves it on this phone for your login. Reset puts the original five back. The side menu still has every page.

notes.title: Installed walls
added: Company has Installed walls, next to Customer.
Dealers can open their own walls after Purchase Order.
notes.how: Open a shipped sales order and click Create installed wall. The wall copies the order, the customer, and the ship address. Warranty end is the ship date plus 3 years. Selected COB also keeps a 5-year support date. Staff can set the site, installer, end customer, pitch, serials, and the spare kit on site. A dealer can read the wall. They cannot change serials or dates.

notes.title: Inventory kits
added: A kit is one sellable SKU made of parts.
notes.how: In Inventory, set Type to Kit under the name. Add each part SKU and how many of that part the kit uses. On a quote you pick the kit, not each part. On-hand is how many complete kits the parts can make. You do not receive or warehouse the kit itself. Purchase orders do not list kits.

notes.title: Dashboard cards cycle
changed: The main pane moves through Website, Inventory, Vendor, CRM, and Customer.
notes.how: The active card is highlighted while the pane is moving. Hover the cards or the main pane to pause. Click a card to hold that view, then the cycle starts again. Leave Dashboard and it stops.

notes.title: Dealer logo and files
added: A dealer logo, shared by Company and the dealer portal.
A Files tab on the dealer.
notes.how: Open a dealer in Company. Click the logo to upload a JPG or PNG. The portal Company page shows that same logo. On Files, staff can view, download, upload, and delete. On the portal, the dealer can view, download, and upload. They cannot delete.

notes.title: Dashboard numbers
changed: Inventory shows this month’s movement in dollars, with on-hand value under it.
Vendor shows how many purchase orders are still open, and their dollars.
Each overview card has a 30-day line.
notes.how: Open Dashboard. The Inventory card is dollars moved this month, not a SKU count. The line under it is what is on hand. The Vendor card is open purchase orders. The small line on each card is the last 30 days.

notes.title: Calculator scroll hint
added: A wheel and three arrows when the calculator’s left side can scroll.
notes.how: Hover the left side of the calculator. The wheel rolls and the three arrows light in order. Move the pointer away and the hint hides.

notes.title: RMA
added: Dealers can submit a return from the portal.
Company → Dealer → RMA is where staff read those returns.
notes.how: On the portal, open RMA and click New RMA. Enter an order or purchase order number, a reason, the SKU lines, and notes. Submit assigns a number and sets the status to Submitted. The dealer can open it again. They cannot approve or close it. This does not create a credit or a shipping label.

notes.title: Deal registration
added: A dealer can register one named job.
Company → Dealer → Deal registration is where staff accept or decline it.
notes.how: On the portal, open Deal registration. Submit the end customer, job name, site, and what they are selling. Company accepts it until a date, or declines it with a reason the dealer can read. Protection is that job only. From a protected job, Request quote for this job opens a quote tied to that registration.

notes.title: Help on each page
added: A ? beside Sign out that explains the page you are on.
A short menu tour the first time you sign in.
notes.how: Click ? beside Sign out. The card says what this page is for. The first sign-in walks the main menu. Skip or Done remembers you on this browser. Show menu tour on that card plays it again.

notes.title: What’s new, and a guide you can reopen
added: A What’s new log of screen changes, in plain language.
A guide that lists what each Company and Dealer Portal menu is for.
A refresh bar if you left a tab open while we updated.
notes.how: After you sign in, a card appears if there is a note you have not seen. Click Got it to dismiss it, or See all updates to open the full log. You can reopen it any time: Settings → What’s new. Settings → Company guide (or Dealer guide) explains every menu. If you keep this tab open and we ship a change, a bar at the top asks you to refresh when you are ready. It does not refresh by itself, so a quote you are still typing is not wiped.

company.title: Dashboard
company.text: Your start page. The main pane cycles through Website, Inventory, Vendor, CRM, and Customer. Hover or click a card to hold that view. Inventory shows this month’s movement in dollars, with on-hand value under it. Vendor shows open purchase orders and their dollars. Each card has a 30-day line.

company.title: CRM → Lead
company.text: A new inquiry. Open it, assign it, and turn it into a customer when they are ready to buy.

company.title: CRM → Pipeline
company.text: Deals in progress, stage by stage. Move a deal forward when the next step happens.

company.title: CRM → Activity
company.text: Calls, emails, and tasks that are due. Use this so a follow-up does not sit.

company.title: Customer
company.text: Companies you already sell to. Open an account for contacts, addresses, and what you have sold them. The Price block shows the brand percent for their customer type. Type a different percent to use that number for this customer.

company.title: Customer → Sales Quote
company.text: A price you send before they buy. Build it, email it, and turn it into an order when they say yes.

company.title: Customer → Sales Order
company.text: A confirmed sale. What they are buying, where it ships, and where the order stands.

company.title: Customer → Invoice
company.text: What they owe. Send it, then mark it paid when the money comes in.

company.title: Installed walls
company.text: A wall that has shipped. Create one from a shipped sales order. Open it for the site, serials, spare kit, and warranty dates. Warranty end is the ship date plus 3 years. Selected COB also keeps a 5-year support date.

company.title: Dealer
company.text: Dealers you already work with. Open one for contacts, a portal login, the logo, files, and what you have sold them. Click the logo to upload a JPG or PNG. On Files you can view, download, upload, or delete.

company.title: Dealer → Applications
company.text: Dealer applications that came in from the site. Open one, then approve or decline it.

company.title: Dealer → Deal registration
company.text: A named job a dealer registered. Accept it until a date, or decline it with a reason. Protection is that job only. Click a column header to sort, move, hide, or resize the list.

company.title: Dealer → RMA
company.text: Return requests from dealers. Open one to see the order, the reason, the picture, and where it stands. This does not create a credit or a shipping label.

company.title: Inventory
company.text: What is in the warehouse. Look up an item and see how many you have, then open it to change the qty or the details. Changing Cost asks before Sell, Dealer, and Integrator prices change. A kit is one sellable SKU made of parts. On a quote you pick the kit. On-hand is how many complete kits the parts can make.

company.title: Inventory → Location
company.text: Your warehouses and bins. Use this when the same item sits in more than one place.

company.title: Inventory → Receipt Shipment
company.text: A shipment that arrived. Match it to the purchase order so the on-hand qty goes up.

company.title: Vendor
company.text: Companies you buy from. Open a supplier to see their contact, terms, and the products you buy from them.

company.title: Vendor → Purchase Order
company.text: An order you send to a vendor. Write it, email it, and keep it here until the goods arrive.

company.title: Calculator
company.text: Size an LED wall for a job. Enter the screen size, pick a panel, and save the layout when you are ready to quote it. Hover the left side to see that the pane scrolls.

company.title: Website → Products
company.text: The panel series on the public product pages. Change photos, specs, and which series are live.

company.title: Website → Store
company.text: What shoppers can buy on the US Store. Set the street price and the qty that can sell, then sync those items so checkout works.

company.title: Website → Accounts
company.text: People who created a website login. Look someone up when they cannot sign in or you need to see their account.

company.title: Website → Traffic
company.text: Who visited the site and which pages they opened. Use it to see what is getting attention.

company.title: Chat
company.text: A message to other staff. Use it while you are still on the quote, order, or customer you are talking about.

company.title: Phone bar
company.text: On a phone, the bottom bar holds five menus: Calculator, Inventory, CRM, Dealer, and Chat. Press and hold an icon to change which five, or their order. The side menu still has every page.

company.title: Settings → Company
company.text: Your company name, address, and logo. This is what prints on quotes, orders, and invoices.

company.title: Settings → Forms
company.text: The layout of quotes, orders, and invoices. Change it here when a document should look different.

company.title: Settings → Brands
company.text: The brand list for inventory, the website, and the store. Open a brand, then Price setting, to set Sell, Dealer, and Integrator prices from cost. Retail and Residential use Sell price. Dealer and AV Integrator use their own price.

company.title: Settings → Manage users
company.text: Staff logins. Add a person, choose what they can open, and turn off someone who left.

company.title: Settings → What’s new
company.text: The log of screen changes. Added, changed, or removed, in plain language. New functions also say where to click.

company.title: Settings → Company guide
company.text: This list. What each menu is for, so someone new can find their way.

portal.title: Dashboard
portal.text: Your home page. The right side shows a Start here card on top and a Recent card below. Finish every Start here step and Recent fills the right side.

portal.title: Dealer book
portal.text: Look up what you can buy and what you pay. Search a SKU, then open the row for your price and how many are on hand. Click a column header to sort, hide, or resize the list.

portal.title: Calculator
portal.text: Size a wall for a job. Enter the screen, pick a panel, and see how many cabinets you need at your price. Save it when you want to quote it.

portal.title: Projects
portal.text: Walls you already sized. Open one to keep editing, or send it as a quote request.

portal.title: Saved Panel
portal.text: Panels you use on more than one job. Pick one so the calculator opens on that panel.

portal.title: Deal registration
portal.text: Tell Spectrum about one job before you quote it. Open it later to see if it was accepted, and the date that protection ends. Protection is that job only.

portal.title: Incoming
portal.text: Jobs Spectrum sends you. Open one and accept or decline it. Accept puts it on your Leads board. Your own jobs stay in Deal registration.

portal.title: Leads
portal.text: Jobs you accepted. Move a card forward as the job moves. Spectrum sees the same board.

portal.title: Request Quote
portal.text: Ask Spectrum to price a job. Click New Request Quote. SKU is first, then the item. Sell price is shown before your dealer price.

portal.title: Purchase Order
portal.text: Orders you have placed. Open one for the lines, ship date, and tracking.

portal.title: Installed walls
portal.text: Walls you installed. Click New Installed Wall to add one, including the warranty start and end. The card shows how many. Open a row to change it.

portal.title: RMA
portal.text: Start a return on something you ordered. Choose a reason and the items. Drop a picture of the problem. Open it later for the return number, the picture, and where it stands.

portal.title: Settings → Company
portal.text: Your company on the portal. The lines are read-only. Update sends a card for Spectrum to review. Account user shows your name and login. Change password is there. Add user sends a name and email for Spectrum to review. Files are in a table. Drop a file or choose one. View opens a preview. Download saves it.

portal.title: Settings → What’s new
portal.text: What changed in the portal. Read it when a screen looks different.

portal.title: Settings → Dealer guide
portal.text: This page. What each menu is for, and a short video of how to use it.
